title: Early 2000s/PS2 era style BattleBots game
author: Spawnfeul
selftext:
Hello! Had a little bit of nostalgia and inspiration and I decided to cook this demo up in about a week-ish time. Scrap Heap Heroes lets you build a battle bot and partecipate in arena fights to earn renown for your garage. Gave it a whole anime storyline spin to it as well, so don't expect too much realism, hahaha.   
  
Inspired by that one TV show and similar games of the early 2000s, with some other inspiration from some anime games and tropes for the storyline. Built it on [spawn.co](http://spawn.co) for free.

Also free to play all in your browser, of course: [https://www.spawn.co/@enfeul/scrap-heap-heroes/play](https://www.spawn.co/@enfeul/scrap-heap-heroes/play)

comments.author: SlamGE
comments.body: It's cool :D I don't know the kinds of the game.. but it reminds me of 2000s.

comments.author: freqCake
comments.body:
I have thought a lot about a game like this! If you want some little ideas I had with it:

Using material voxels, with price weight and strength, so like you can have a steel axle or a carbon fiber rod and they break apart realistically and have realistic strength and weight and price

  
In battlebots in real life you control it from outside the grid, it would be cool to have a mode where you stand outside the grid looking in. Especially if you can hear parts break off and smash against the grid plexyglass wall.

comments.body: Reminds me of the old Robot Wars: Extreme Destruction game.
